resources.string: Connect your iPhone to the Linkswell USB data port. CarPlay opens automatically.
Allow the microphone for Siri and calls. Android may also ask once to allow the wired CarPlay connection.
Keep your iPhone plugged in. Unlock it and accept the CarPlay prompt if asked.
Your iPhone is connected by USB.
Unlock your iPhone, check its CarPlay prompt, then try again. If needed, reconnect the USB cable or try another data cable.
This build is missing the CarPlay authentication files. They must be included in a local build before CarPlay can connect.
Enlarges the apps, text and dock inside CarPlay. Extra large is the starting size for this truck. After changing it, unplug and reconnect your iPhone to apply it. Larger sizes show less content.

Built from CarLink by F-e-n-y-x and DiPlay by shihabal3amri, based on xcertplay by shilapi. Earlier CarLink work also incorporated DiAuto and Open Headunit. Original licenses and credits are preserved in the source. CarPlay belongs to Apple; this project is independent and uses experimental CarPlay support.
Wired CarPlay uses a private USB connection. Android asks once to allow it.
